puffin.why: Compound noun + prepositional phrase (papagaio-do-mar): only the first noun element pluralizes; the de-phrase stays invariant.

seahorse.why: Noun+adjective compound: both elements pluralize. Matches the sibling key 'sea-horse' which already has 'Cavalos-marinhos'.

snowdrop.why: Compound flor-de-neve: pluralize the head noun (flor->flores); the de-neve phrase stays invariant.

robin.why: Lemma mismatch: plural was a different bird (pintarroxo) than the singular 'Pisco-de-peito-ruivo'. Plural must be that of the singular lemma; compound head pisco->piscos.

rock.why: Lemma mismatch: singular 'Pedra' but plural given as 'Rochas' (a different word, rocha). Plural of pedra is pedras.

snake.why: Lemma mismatch: singular 'Cobra' but plural given as 'Serpentes' (different word). Plural of cobra is cobras.

planet.why: planeta (the celestial body) is masculine: o planeta.

pipe-wrench.why: Head noun 'chave' (chave de grifo) is feminine: a chave.

screwdriver.why: Head noun 'chave' (chave de fenda) is feminine: a chave.

snow-shovel.why: Head noun 'pa' (pa de neve) is feminine: a pa.

potato-chips.why: Head noun 'batata' (batatas chips) is feminine: a batata.

rain-boots.why: Head noun 'bota' (botas de chuva) is feminine: a bota.

snow-boots.why: Head noun 'bota' (botas de neve) is feminine: a bota.
